verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents source-available triggers and actions in a public GitHub repo that accepts component PRs, so part of the product's source can be read. The docs say 'source-available', not open-licensed, and a community user notes the workflow engine itself is not open source, so only the integration components are readable. Missing for 10: an explicitly stated open license, source for the core workflow engine/platform, independent confirmation of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Source-available triggers and actions for thousands of integrated apps
You can also create a PR to contribute new components via GitHub.
I wish the workflow engine itself was open source too
